Context: Particle flipbooks require a texture size that is an exact multiple of the layout size. For example, if your layout is 4x4, your texture must be a size that can be perfectly divided by that grid, such as 64x64 or 128x128.
Source: The texture size must be an exact multiple of the flipbook layout size.
en-us: The texture size must be an exact multiple of the flipbook layout size.
